A weaving track that flips the switch on slow fish.

As the spoon swims back to you, a weaving motion enters the track. That zigzag is what defines the NOA-S, and it is what flips the switch on fish in a slow mood.

The 1.4 g and 1.0 g are chosen mainly by retrieve speed, but each weight weaves differently, so it is worth fishing both to feel it.

When the NOA-S is dialled in, nothing else comes close.
